Type: pleated stoneware floor vase
Use: holding tall stems or as display decor; living room, dining room, entry, on a console or floor
Style: modern, contemporary, minimalist
Materials: glazed stoneware, glossy finish
Colors: white
Shape: tall tapered body with origami-like pleated angled facets, wide open mouth, large and sculptural
Feel: crisp, bright, sculptural
Goes with: light wood, grey walls, brass or black accents; modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Angled Stoneware Home Decor Flower Vase - 12 Inch, White
product.description: Neutral white with angled patterns allow it to blend with any room 100% stoneware with transparent glaze 5.9"Diameter x 11.9" H Durable stoneware vase great for display or holding flowers. Folds and angles bring a chic design to this contemporary stoneware vase. The lovely milky white color with transparent glaze will go with any décor. Add flowers if you wish, but this vase can also stand alone as a decorative piece.
